# Data Preparation

## Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, results = "hide", fig.show = "hide", message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, include = TRUE, eval = FALSE)
```

## Packages

```{r Load Packages}
library(dplyr)
library(psych)
library(misty)
library(apaTables)
library(jtools)
library(interactions)
library(sandwich)
library(ggplot2)
library(emmeans)
library(brms)
library(sjPlot)
library(lavaan)
library(haven)
```

## Dataset

```{r load dataset}
df = file.choose() # NZAVS T10 (2018) SPSS Base Dataset
dataset = read.spss(df, to.data.frame=TRUE)
```

```{r Subset sample to NZ European participants}
mydf <- subset(dataset, EthL2.Euro.T10 == 1)
```

```{r Clean Data}
mydf$GRD1 <- mydf$Depriv.Ethnic01.T10
mydf$GRD2 <- mydf$Derpiv.Ethnic02.T10

mydf$EthID <- (mydf$EthID01.T10+mydf$EthID02.T10+mydf$EthID03.T10)/3

mydf$SDO <- (mydf$SDO01.T10+mydf$SDO02.T10+mydf$SDO03.T10+mydf$SDO04r.T10+mydf$SDO05r.T10+mydf$SDO06r.T10)/6

mydf$GRD <- (mydf$Depriv.Ethnic01.T10+mydf$Derpiv.Ethnic02.T10)/2

mydf$IRD <- (mydf$Depriv.Self01.T10+mydf$Depriv.Self02.T10)/2

mydf$Nationalism <- (mydf$Nationalism01.T10+mydf$Nationalism02.T10)/2

mydf$Patriotism <- (mydf$Patriotism01.T10+mydf$Patriotism02.T10)/2

mydf$Education <- mydf$IMD2018_EducationD.T10
mydf$Income <- mydf$IMD2018_IncomeD.T10
mydf$Deprivation <- mydf$NZDep.2018.T10
mydf$Age <- mydf$Age.T10
mydf$Gender <- mydf$Gender.T10
mydf$PolOrient <- mydf$Pol.Orient.T10
```

## Sociodemographics

```{r deciles education}
category_counts <- table(mydf$Education)

category_percentages <- prop.table(category_counts) * 100

category_percentages
```

```{r Dichotimize education variable}
mydf$Education_d <- car::recode(mydf$Education, "1:5 = '0'; 6:10 = '1'")
```

```{r deciles income}
category_counts <- table(mydf$IMD2018_IncomeD.T10)

category_percentages <- prop.table(category_counts) * 100

category_percentages
```

```{r log Income}
mydf$logIncome <- log(mydf$Income)
```

## Reliability of Scales

```{r Reliability Nationalism}
cor.test(mydf$Nationalism01.T10, mydf$Nationalism02.T10, method=c("pearson"))
```

```{r Reliability Patriotism}
cor.test(mydf$Patriotism01.T10, mydf$Patriotism02.T10, method=c("pearson"))
```

```{r Reliability GRD}
cor.test(mydf$Depriv.Ethnic01.T10, mydf$Derpiv.Ethnic02.T10, method=c("pearson"))
```

```{r Reliability SDO}
items_SDO <- c("SDO01.T10","SDO02.T10","SDO03.T10","SDO04r.T10","SDO05r.T10","SDO06r.T10")
mydf[items_SDO]
psych::alpha(mydf[items_SDO])
```

```{r Reliability IRD}
cor.test(mydf$Depriv.Self01.T10, mydf$Depriv.Self02.T10, method=c("pearson"))
```

## Mean Centering

```{r Mean Centering}
mydf$SDO.m = as.numeric(scale(mydf$SDO, scale =F))
mydf$GRD.m = as.numeric(scale(mydf$GRD, scale =F))
mydf$GRD1.m = as.numeric(scale(mydf$Depriv.Ethnic01.T10, scale =F))
mydf$GRD2.m = as.numeric(scale(mydf$Derpiv.Ethnic02.T10, scale =F))
mydf$Patriotism.m = as.numeric(scale(mydf$Patriotism, scale =F))
mydf$Nationalism.m = as.numeric(scale(mydf$Nationalism, scale =F))
mydf$Ethid.m = as.numeric(scale(mydf$EthID, scale =F))
mydf$IRD.m = as.numeric(scale(mydf$IRD, scale =F))
mydf$PolOrient.m = as.numeric(scale(mydf$PolOrient, scale =F))
mydf$Depriv.m = as.numeric(scale(mydf$Deprivation, scale =F))
mydf$Age.m = as.numeric(scale(mydf$Age.T10, scale =F))
mydf$Gender.m = as.numeric(scale(mydf$Gender.T10, scale =F))
mydf$Education.m = as.numeric(scale(mydf$Education_d, scale =F))
mydf$logIncome.m = as.numeric(scale(mydf$Income, scale =F))
```

## Standardisation

```{r Standardisation}
mydf$SDO_std = as.numeric(scale(mydf$SDO, scale =T))
mydf$GRD_std = as.numeric(scale(mydf$GRD, scale =T))
mydf$GRD1_std = as.numeric(scale(mydf$Depriv.Ethnic01.T10, scale =T))
mydf$GRD2_std = as.numeric(scale(mydf$Derpiv.Ethnic02.T10, scale =T))
mydf$Patriotism_std = as.numeric(scale(mydf$Patriotism, scale =T))
mydf$Nationalism_std = as.numeric(scale(mydf$Nationalism, scale =T))
mydf$Ethid_std = as.numeric(scale(mydf$EthID, scale =T))
mydf$IRD_std = as.numeric(scale(mydf$IRD, scale =T))
mydf$PolOrient_std = as.numeric(scale(mydf$PolOrient, scale =T))
mydf$Depriv_std = as.numeric(scale(mydf$Deprivation, scale =T))
mydf$Age_std = as.numeric(scale(mydf$Age.T10, scale =T))
mydf$Gender_std = as.numeric(scale(mydf$Gender.T10, scale =T))
mydf$Education_std = as.numeric(scale(mydf$Education_d, scale =T))
mydf$logIncome_std = as.numeric(scale(mydf$Income, scale =T))
```

## Create Correlation Table

```{r Correlation Table}
nztable <- select(mydf, Nationalism, Patriotism, Depriv.Ethnic01.T10, Derpiv.Ethnic02.T10, SDO, IRD, Education_d,  Income, EthID ,  PolOrient , Deprivation, Age, Gender)

apa.cor.table(nztable,
              filename = "nztable.doc",
              table.number = 3,
              show.sig.stars = TRUE,
              landscape = TRUE
)
```

# GRD Full Models

## GRD Full Model

```{r Path Model GRDmean}

mydf$int <- mydf$GRD.m*mydf$SDO.m

model1 <- '
# regressions
Nationalism ~ b1*GRD.m + b2*SDO.m + b3*int
Patriotism ~ b4*GRD.m + b5*SDO.m + b6*int

# residual covariance of DVs
Nationalism ~~ Patriotism

# Simple Slopes Nationalism

N_SDOHigh := b1+b3*0.95
N_SDOMed := b1+b3*0
N_SDOLow := b1+b3*(-0.95)

# Simple Slopes Patriotism

P_SDOHigh := b4+b6*0.95
P_SDOMed := b4+b6*0
P_SDOLow := b4+b6*(-0.95)
'

fit1 <- lavaan::sem(model = model1, data = mydf, fixed.x = FALSE,
                    meanstructure = TRUE)
summary(fit1, fit.measures=TRUE)

parameter_estimates <- parameterEstimates(fit1, ci = TRUE)
print(parameter_estimates)

```

## GRD Full Model STD

```{r Path Model GRDmean Standardized}

mydf$int <- mydf$GRD.m*mydf$SDO.m

model1.1 <- '
# regressions
Nationalism_std ~ b1*GRD_std + b2*SDO_std + b3*int
Patriotism_std ~ b4*GRD_std + b5*SDO_std + b6*int

# residual covariance of DVs
Nationalism_std ~~ Patriotism_std

# Simple Slopes Nationalism

N_SDOHigh := b1+b3*0.95
N_SDOMed := b1+b3*0
N_SDOLow := b1+b3*(-0.95)

# Simple Slopes Patriotism

P_SDOHigh := b4+b6*0.95
P_SDOMed := b4+b6*0
P_SDOLow := b4+b6*(-0.95)
'

fit1.1 <- lavaan::sem(model = model1.1, data = mydf, fixed.x = FALSE,
                    meanstructure = TRUE)
summary(fit1.1, fit.measures=TRUE)

parameter_estimates <- parameterEstimates(fit1.1, ci = TRUE)
print(parameter_estimates)
```

## GRD Full Model Visualisation

```{r Visualisation Simple Slopes}

df <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(GRD) & !is.na(SDO) & !is.na(Nationalism))


model2 <- lm(data = df, Nationalism ~  GRD*SDO)

# Plot the model with confidence intervals
object <- sjPlot::plot_model(model2, type = "int", 
                   terms = c("GRD", "SDO[mean(SDO, na.rm = TRUE) - sd(SDO, na.rm = TRUE), 
                                     mean(SDO, na.rm = TRUE), 
                                     mean(SDO, na.rm = TRUE) + sd(SDO, na.rm = TRUE)]")+
  labs(x = "GRD") +
  labs(y = "Nationalism") +
  labs(color = "SDO"))

tiff("Figure4.tiff", units="in", width=7, height=5, res=300, type = "cairo")

plot <- object +
  # Confidence interval ribbons with transparency
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, fill = group), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  
  # Add lines with different linetypes based on group (SDO levels)
  geom_line(aes(linetype = group), size = 1.3) +
  
  # Customize the color scheme and linetypes
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#002C54", "#C5001A"), labels = c("Low SDO (-1 SD)", "High SDO (+1 SD)")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#002C54", "#C5001A")) +
  
  # Add linetype for the dotted line (e.g., "dashed" or "dotted")
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "dotted"), labels = c("Low SDO (-1 SD)", "High SDO (+1 SD)")) +
  
  # Set x-axis limits from 1 to 4
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1, 7), breaks = seq(1, 7, 2)) +
  
  # Set y-axis limits to start at 2, and ensure it shows only whole numbers
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(1, 7), breaks = seq(1, 7, 1)) +
  
  # Add labels for axes and legend
  labs(x = "GRD", y = "Nationalism", color = "SDO", linetype = "SDO", fill = "Confidence Interval", 
       title = NULL) +
  
  # Customize the theme
  theme_apa() +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.185, 0.84),  # Adjust legend position inside plot
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, margin = margin(t = 0, r = 10, b = 0, l = 0))
  )

# Display the plot
plot

# Close the TIFF file
dev.off()
```

# Affective GRD Models

## GRD1 Model

```{r Path Model Affective GRD}

mydf$int <- mydf$GRD1.m*mydf$SDO.m

model2 <- '
# regressions
Nationalism ~ b1*GRD1.m + b2*SDO.m + b3*int
Patriotism ~ b4*GRD1.m + b5*SDO.m + b6*int

# residual covariance of DVs
Nationalism ~~ Patriotism

# Simple Slopes Nationalism
N_SDOHigh := b1+b3*0.95
N_SDOMed := b1+b3*0
N_SDOLow := b1+b3*(-0.95)

# Simple Slopes Patriotism

P_SDOHigh := b4+b6*0.95
P_SDOMed := b4+b6*0
P_SDOLow := b4+b6*(-0.95)
'

fit2 <- lavaan::sem(model = model2, data = mydf, fixed.x = FALSE,
                    meanstructure = TRUE)
summary(fit2, fit.measures=TRUE)

parameter_estimates <- parameterEstimates(fit2, ci = TRUE)
print(parameter_estimates)
```
